metadata.source: User-provided rule table (29 rules across Revenue/COGS/OpEx/Below-the-Line)
notes: This seed file is consumed by `bankKeywordRules:seedDefaults` (to be implemented in Phase 72).

Account refs are LOGICAL names (e.g. 'revenue-direct-sales'). The seeder resolves each to an accounts._id by account name or code. If any ref cannot be resolved, seed should fail loudly with the unresolved ref list — never silently skip.

Direction is a first-class predicate because OVO (credit=revenue vs debit=logistics), Shopee (credit=marketplace payout vs debit=e-commerce supplies), and Tokopedia behave differently on debit vs credit sides.

IMPORTANT — REAL BCA INPUT HAS NO COUNTERPARTY COLUMN. The actual BCA XLSX export has ONE description field (Keterangan) that contains counterparty name, reference codes, and memo text all concatenated. Therefore `counterpartyPatterns` and `descriptionPatterns` are BOTH evaluated as case-insensitive substring searches against the SAME rawDescription field. Semantic intent: `counterpartyPatterns` captures names/entity strings (e.g. 'DOMPET ANAK BANGSA', 'RISTIANA ETENG'), `descriptionPatterns` captures memo/reference keywords (e.g. 'BIAYA ADM', 'investment'). Evaluation treats them identically at runtime — the label is for human readability of the rule set only.

Rules may combine counterparty AND descriptionPatterns. Semantics: counterparty (if present) must match (any) AND descriptionPatterns (if present, per descriptionPatternsMode) must match. Both are substring-in-rawDescription checks.
Precedence: higher `priority` evaluated first; first match wins. Ties broken by ruleCode ascending for determinism.
R01 is a catch-all (isCatchAll=true) — it matches any unmatched credit as Direct Sales. It must be evaluated LAST regardless of priority — the engine checks `isCatchAll` as a tiebreaker.

realInputFormat.comment: Grounded in actual BCA XLSX sample parsed during discuss-phase 2026-04-12 (Mutasi - BCA - 2511.xlsx). See CONTEXT.md D-06a and D-28 for full parser contract.
realInputFormat.sheetLayout: XLSX single-sheet, 5 columns (A: date 'DD-Mon', B: Keterangan description, C: Jumlah amount 'Rp X,XXX,XXX', D: DB/empty direction flag, E: Saldo balance)
realInputFormat.reconciliationCheckRequired: sum(debits) == Mutasi Debet AND sum(credits) == Mutasi Kredit AND opening + credits - debits == closing. Abort import on mismatch.
realInputFormat.dateFormat: DD-Mon with Indonesian month abbreviations (Jan/Feb/Mar/Apr/Mei/Jun/Jul/Agu/Sep/Okt/Nov/Des). Year inferred from Periode metadata.

precedenceTiers.100: Named personal/entity counterparties (cafe owners, individual owners) — R11, R12, B02
precedenceTiers.80: Platform counterparties (GoPay, OVO, Tokopedia, AirPay, Katiga, Skala Pangan) — R02, R03, R04, R05, R06, R07
precedenceTiers.60: Description pattern + counterparty (COGS material suppliers, /LALAMOVE, /OVO, /SHOPEE, /TOKOPEDIA, CapEx keywords, payroll counterparty) — C01, C02, C03, O01, O03, O04, O06, O07, B01
precedenceTiers.40: Description keyword + direction (shipping, printing, legal, R&D, refunds, auto-credit patterns) — O02, O05, O08, O09, R08, R09, R10

directionSemantics.credit: Money in — Col F in BCA CSV. Classified as revenue or equity inflow.
directionSemantics.debit: Money out — Col E in BCA CSV. Classified as expense, COGS, CapEx, or owner draw.

ambiguityNotes: OVO CREDIT (from VISIONET) = Revenue R03. OVO DEBIT (to /OVO VA) = Logistics O04. Do NOT confuse.
Sticker/Stickers keyword overlaps C02 (packaging) and O05 (marketing printing). Disambiguated by counterparty: NIU ULUNG/NILSON → packaging; PILAR/JOSS PRINT/RASA BOGA → printing.
RAQUEL AMA + NIDIA were formerly Direct Sales. Reclassified 2026-04-12 to their respective Cafe channels. Historical bank lines matched before this date may need backfill.
metadata.capexSpecialHandling: B01 rows identify CapEx (equipment/machinery). Auto-JE posting in P73 should NOT simply debit a generic Fixed Assets account — it should route through the Asset Register intake flow (Phase 45+) so the asset gets proper depreciation schedule setup. Flag this on the line (flags: ['capex_needs_asset_register']) so P73 can branch the confirmation UX.

accountRefs.comment: Logical account names referenced by rules below. Seeder resolves each to accounts._id. Accounts that don't exist yet must be added to the CoA before seeding rules.

refs.noteIfMergedWithTokopedia: User's rule table groups R05 under same 'Marketplace Payouts (Tokopedia)' category — seeder may reuse `revenue-marketplace-tokopedia` if business wants single marketplace bucket. Left as separate ref for flexibility; defaults to merge.

refs.accountName: OpEx — R&D / Telecom / Office / Bank Fees

rules.notes: Catch-all for direct bank transfer orders from customers. Evaluated LAST after all other rules fail to match any credit line.
GoPay/GoFood platform payouts. PT Dompet Anak Bangsa is GoPay's legal entity. Multiple daily settlements with unique WLST transaction IDs.
OVO/ShopeePay platform payouts. PT Visionet Internasional is OVO's parent entity. CREDIT direction only — /OVO DEBIT is handled by O04 (logistics).
Tokopedia marketplace settlement payouts. Distinct from ShopeePay (R03). CREDIT only — /TOKOPEDIA DEBIT is handled by O07.

Shopee marketplace payouts via AirPay International. User's table merges into 'Marketplace Payouts (Tokopedia)' — deployer may choose to point categoryRef at `revenue-marketplace-tokopedia` for a single marketplace bucket.
Katiga Ritel retail platform settlements. Grouped under marketplace category per user's table.
Revenue share or wholesale orders from Skala Pangan (food distributor). B2B direct sales channel.
Automatic standing order transfers — recurring customer payments via BCA auto-debit.
BI-FAST interbank credits — customers paying from non-BCA banks. Bank codes in description identify source bank (008, 054, 535, 542, 501, 562, etc.).
Contra-revenue: debits sent to customers for returned products or shipping errors. NEGATED against revenue in P&L (reduces revenue line, not an expense).
Reclassified 2026-04-12 from Direct Sales. Raquel Ama deposits are wholesale cafe orders for Ruma 52 — tracked as separate channel.
Reclassified 2026-04-12 from Direct Sales. Nidia deposits are wholesale cafe orders for Thirdhome — tracked as separate channel.
Direct material purchases — raw ingredients, moulds, specialty baking supplies. Match succeeds if counterparty OR description keyword matches.
Bags, stickers, mochi wraps. Counterparty NIU ULUNG / NILSON TANDIONO distinguishes from O05 (marketing printing) when keyword 'Sticker' appears.
rules.ambiguityNote: 'Stickers' keyword overlaps with O05 printing. Counterparty is the disambiguator — if counterparty not in this list, consider O05.

rules.notes: Pierre is the production contractor. 'Porudksi' typo preserved as observed in real bank data. Requires BOTH counterparty AND keyword to avoid false positives — Pierre also receives shipping reimbursements (see O02).
Currently one identified employee (Madelynne). Counterparty-anchored so priority 60 even though listed under Tier 4 in user table.
Courier fees and transport charges. Requires counterparty AND description keyword to disambiguate from C03 (Pierre production) and C02 (Nilson packaging).
LalaMove on-demand delivery payments. Matched by '/LALAMOVE' VA marker.

RECLASSIFIED from 'OVO Float Top-up' to logistics. OVO balance is used exclusively to pay LalaMove. DEBIT direction only — OVO CREDIT is R03 (revenue). Direction is critical to avoid misclassification.
Labels, packaging design prints, marketing materials. Requires counterparty AND keyword to disambiguate 'Sticker' from C02 (packaging stickers).
rules.ambiguityNote: Keyword 'Sticker' overlaps with C02 — counterparty disambiguates.

rules.notes: Shopee purchase debits — may include packaging, inventory, or platform fees. Mix of categories; should surface for P73 review. DEBIT only — Shopee CREDIT is R05 (marketplace revenue).
Tokopedia purchase debits. DEBIT only — Tokopedia CREDIT is R04 (marketplace revenue).
Trademark/patent registration fees. One-time legal costs for brand protection.
Catch-all for: R&D experiments, office supplies, telecom (BY.U) top-ups, BCA admin fees (BIAYA ADM), BI-FAST transaction fees (BIAYA TXN). Grouped because individually immaterial.

Capital expenditure — long-lived assets capitalised on balance sheet (useful life >1 year). CONFIRMATION IN P73 SHOULD NOT simply post a DR to Fixed Assets — it should route through Asset Register intake so depreciation schedule gets set up. Flag `capex_needs_asset_register` surfaces this.

Owner/related-party distributions — NOT operating expenses. Tania, Ristiana, Natasha identified as owners. If any of these individuals become employees, reclassify to Payroll (O01). Overrides R09 (BI-FAST CR direction) because this is DEBIT direction with named counterparty.

schemaExtensionsRequired.comment: Parsing these real rules reveals the `bankKeywordRules` schema sketched in CONTEXT.md D-16 needs these extensions. CONTEXT.md D-16 has been updated accordingly.

fields.counterpartyPatterns: v.optional(v.array(v.string())) — counterparty name variants (case-insensitive contains match)
fields.descriptionPatternsMode: v.union(v.literal('any'), v.literal('all'), v.literal('hint')) — 'hint' = not required for match, only raises confidence
fields.matchType: v.union(v.literal('counterparty'), v.literal('description_contains'), v.literal('description_exact'), v.literal('description_regex'), v.literal('counterparty_or_keyword'), v.literal('counterparty_and_keyword'), v.literal('catch_all'))
fields.isCatchAll: v.boolean() — catch-all rules evaluate LAST regardless of priority
